piezas.titulo: Written production: Greetings and polite phrases
texto: When writing basic social phrases in Thai, pay attention to writing each compound word together, without spaces, and choose the polite particle according to the usual convention for the register (ครับ or ค่ะ). Practise by recognising full greetings that come with expressions of thanks or respectful apology.
